name: zone-mpoint-coupling
full_name: Coupled FLAC3D zones + MPM material points
description: Zones and material points can live in one model and be solved together -- a continuum foundation carrying a large-deformation MPM body, say. The coupling is NOT automatic: 'mpoint hybrid-points' registers the zone gridpoints as hybrid (coupled) points, and without it the two systems cycle side by side and exchange nothing.

steps.command: zone create brick size 8 4 8 point 0 (0,0,0) point 1 (4,0,0) point 2 (0,1,0) point 3 (0,0,2)
steps.why: The continuum part. Stays as zones.

steps.command: zone create brick size 8 4 8 point 0 (0,0,2) point 1 (4,0,2) point 2 (0,1,2) point 3 (0,0,4) group 'mpm'
steps.why: The part that becomes material points. Group it so the import can select it.

steps.command: zone cmodel assign elastic range group 'mpm'
zone property density 2000 young 2e7 poisson 0.25 range group 'mpm'

steps.why: Ranged import: only the grouped zones are converted, the rest stay zones.

THE coupling step. Without it the MPM body's weight does not reach the zones at all -- measured settlement was identical to eight significant figures with the body present and absent. With it, settlement went from -0.000797 to -0.00469.

steps.command: zone gridpoint fix velocity range position-z 0
mpoint node fix velocity range position-z 0

verified.result: Three-way comparison of the foundation's top settlement: bare foundation -0.000797; MPM body resting on it but uncoupled -0.000797 (identical); with 'mpoint hybrid-points' -0.00469. Both systems advance in one 'model cycle'.
